class.name: AudioStreamMIDISequencer
class.brief_description: A live, code-driven OPL3 synthesizer with no fixed song.
class.description:
An [AudioStream] with no fixed song: a live OPL3 synthesizer driven entirely from code, for procedurally generated music. Beyond the synthesizer parameters inherited from [AudioStreamMIDIBase] ([code]num_chips[/code], [code]emulator[/code], ...), it adds nothing of its own — actually playing notes is done through the [AudioStreamPlaybackMIDISequencer] instance it produces. [codeblock] var stream := AudioStreamMIDISequencer.new() player.stream = stream player.play()
var playback := player.get_stream_playback() as AudioStreamPlaybackMIDISequencer playback.note_on(playback.current_time, 0, 60, 100) # Channel 0, middle C, velocity 100. [/codeblock]
